request: 实现官方插件市场：aide-pkg-shop目录与网站，Aide内市场浏览搜索、详情、官方下载、安装更新，保留权限设置与回滚
acceptance: 官方目录固定来源和快照，包摘要/大小/ID/版本匹配才可安装
市场网站可搜索分类、看详情并直接下载真实官方ZIP
Aide插件面板有市场/已安装入口、详情确认、下载和安装/升级状态
升级保留现有设置/启用/数据并复用备份；锁屏/工作空间变化/只读不落盘
离线目录回退明确标识，缓存有大小边界；Safari实见新入口和布局

requirements.summary: 实现用户同意的第一版，官方受控目录；无账号、评论、第三方自动收录。

design.summary: 市场仓库保存静态目录和确定性ZIP；Aide固定读取该仓库不可变快照，安装前确认摘要及宿主版本，复用既有安装升级，权限不放宽。

implementation.summary: Implemented fixed official catalog snapshots, bounded cache, verified download/install/update, candidate loading probes, installed-source revocation guard, market UI, and public market website with 23 actual packages.

verification.summary: 127 final quick checks passed. Race integration for market/upgrade/management/skill passed (52.371s), real 23-package isolated installations passed (20.573s), final market and upgrade guards passed (132.044s). Public Pages site, search, details, MIT/dependency notes and actual hash-verified download observed. Safari narrow plugin panel/details observed. No paid model, real hardware, or Windows/Linux browser acceptance; full product release gate not run.

documentation.summary: Documented catalog, cache, endpoints, compatibility, trust boundaries, publication, dependencies and rollback. Actual public website screenshot retained; no mock screenshot or private workspace screenshot published.

cleanup.summary: Preserve unrelated runtime registry changes unstaged. Remove only own isolated container and preview server after final runtime checks.

release.summary: Market repository e489d34 pushed, Pages workflow 39059666741 succeeded and site/download checked. Aide source push and final local build pending; no version bump or product Release.

release_authorization: User: do it; implements the proposed official repository/Pages market. Local update continues earlier installation/update authorization.
rollback: Revert marketplace source/image together while preserving data volume, registry settings and installed plugin data. Revert market catalog commit for website recommendations. Existing plugin updates retain their upgrade backups; do not purge shared caches or user plugins.
handoff: Official site https://skyelan1999.github.io/aide-pkg-shop/ . Catalog e489d34 has 23 packages, 120983 bytes. First-party repository HTTPS and pinned Git snapshots establish source trust; independent release signing is not implemented. Existing user plugins are not upgraded as a UI acceptance probe. Runtime registry remains local.
